 Heat vs Warriors Prediction, Top Picks & Best Bet for Tonight's NBA Game
 Juan Carlos Blanco 
 • Betting Analyst 
 8+ years betting experience 
 Updated: 
Nov 5, 2026 , 07:04 PM ET
 • 4 min read 
 An improving Heat team looks to shake off a difficult start to the season as it continues its West Coast swing against Stephen Curry and the surging Warriors.
 Jump to section:

 Combo 
 Player Props 
 Odds 
 nba
 Nov 05 • 4:00 PM ET 
 Photo By - Reuters Connect. Giannis Antetokounmpo of the Miami Heat and Stephen Curry of the Golden State Warriors. 
 The Miami Heat are starting to find their groove, but a trip to Golden State to face a Warriors team riding a five-game winning streak is a tough assignment. 
 Golden State's offense is clicking, and Miami could be running on fumes after Wednesday's overtime win. My Heat vs. Warriors prediction expects plenty of points, backing the Over on the 233.5-point total. 
 Tip-off is set for 10 p.m. ET at Chase Center, with the Warriors favored by 7.5 points. 
 Check out our free NBA picks for more betting angles on Thursday, Nov. 5. 
  TOP PICK 
Heat vs Warriors prediction: Over 233.5
 The Golden State Warriors are now averaging 117.5 points per game following their recent surge, so this full-game Over is playable to 235.5. 
 Meanwhile, the Miami Heat bring a nice bump in pace and have surrendered 126.3 ppg over their last three contests . Miami is also allowing opponents to shoot 49.0% from the field on the road, including 40.1% from 3-point range. 
 Miami is playing its third game in four nights Thursday, including the second half of a back-to-back. In Wednesday's overtime win against the Clippers, Giannis Antetokounmpo , Bam Adebayo , and Davion Mitchell each logged 40+ minutes, while valuable reserve Pelle Larsson played 35 minutes off the bench. 
 COVERS INTEL: Since the start of the 2025-26 season, the Over is 24-10 (70.6% hit rate) in Golden State's games where the Warriors have had 2-3 preceding days off. 
 Enjoying Covers content? Add us as a preferred source on your Google account Heat vs Warriors combo
 Golden State has scored between 119 and 134 points in three games during its current winning streak, while the Heat bring a nice bump in pace ( 108.0 possessions per road game ).
 On the second night of a back-to-back, Miami will struggle to keep up defensively with a well-rested Warriors squad. Expect plenty of scoring opportunities for Golden State against a tired Heat defense.
 Heat vs Warriors combo
 Over 233.5
 Warriors -7.5
 Warriors team total Over 120.5
 Heat vs Warriors player props
 Heat player prop: Giannis Antetokounmpo Under 45.5 points + rebounds + assists
 Miami is a fairly sizable road underdog, with an implied team total suggesting a more subdued night than usual for its front-line players.
 If the game plays out as oddsmakers expect, it wouldn't be surprising to see Antetokounmpo's night end a bit early , especially with Miami still having two more games on its West Coast swing.
 Warriors player prop: Yaxel Lendeborg Over 29.5 points + rebounds + assists 
 Like the rest of his teammates, Yaxel  Lendeborg  will  enjoy a valuable rest advantage over any defender he faces and enters Thursday averaging 34.6 PRA since the second game of the season . 
 The Heat also rank 27th in offensive efficiency rating allowed to small forwards (25.9) while surrendering the second-most rebounds (9.5) and most assists (6.3) per game to the position. 
 The additional possessions created by Miami's pace of play should also work in Lendeborg's favor, as should the Heat's tendency to allow efficient shooting from opponents on the road.
